title: Using AI Tools in Email Marketing | Mailchimp

facts.fact: Mailchimp's page promotes a free 14-day trial for its email marketing platform.
facts.quote: Join Mailchimp with a free 14-day trial or save 15% off on 10,000+ contacts.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's page promotes a 15% discount for users with 10,000+ contacts (a vendor promotion, not a third-party figure).
facts.quote: Join Mailchimp with a free 14-day trial or save 15% off on 10,000+ contacts.

facts.fact: Mailchimp defines AI email marketing as the process of using machine learning to enhance email marketing strategies and campaigns.
facts.quote: The process of using machine learning to enhance email marketing strategies and campaigns.
